# Algebraic theories and their models

::: {#def-algebraic-theory}

Let $\mathbf{Set}_\omega$ denote the full subcategory of $\mathbf{Set}$ consisting of only the finite ordinals.
A *Lawvere theory* is a category $\mathcal T$ equipped with a functor $J \colon \mathbf{Set}_\omega^\op \to \mathcal T$ which is
bijective on objects and preserves finite products.
